turns.question: Which day of the week had the highest average daily ad spend across all campaigns in September 2026, and what was that average in EUR?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-daily-spend metric, so I cannot give a per-weekday average in EUR; the closest metric is ad_spend_eur, which by weekday for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 gives totals (not averages) of 820 EUR Monday, 1,040 Tuesday, 1,060 Wednesday, 860 Thursday, 830 Friday, 830 Saturday and 830 Sunday, the highest total being Wednesday at 1,060 EUR. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
